import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.GaloisDescent.PicEtGaloisBridge
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtQuotientHom

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry Limits
open AlgebraicJacobian.GaloisDescent

namespace Probe

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {k' : Type u} [Field k'] [Algebra k k']

open AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PicScheme

theorem baseAut_comp (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    (toSpecAut (k' ≃ₐ[k] k') k' γ).hom ≫ specMapAlgebra k k' = specMapAlgebra k k' := by
  have h : (toSpecAut (k' ≃ₐ[k] k') k' γ).hom = specGal (k := k) γ⁻¹ := by
    rw [toSpecAut_hom]; rfl
  rw [h, specGal_comp]

noncomputable abbrev Tw (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k')) ⥤ Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k')) :=
  Over.map (toSpecAut (k' ≃ₐ[k] k') k' γ).hom

noncomputable def twRestrict (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    Tw (k := k) γ ⋙ restrictTest k k' ≅ restrictTest k k' :=
  (Over.mapComp _ _).symm ≪≫ Over.mapCongr _ _ (baseAut_comp γ)

theorem twRestrict_hom_app_left (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k')
    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k'))) :
    ((twRestrict (k := k) γ).hom.app T).left = 𝟙 T.left := by
  simp [twRestrict, Over.mapComp, Over.mapCongr]

section Act

variable (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]

noncomputable def actRestricted (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    (Tw (k := k) γ).op ⋙ ((restrictTest k k').op ⋙ picEt C)
      ≅ (restrictTest k k').op ⋙ picEt C :=
  (Functor.associator _ _ _).symm ≪≫
    Functor.isoWhiskerRight (NatIso.op (twRestrict (k := k) γ)).symm (picEt C)

theorem actRestricted_hom_app (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k'))) :
    (actRestricted C γ).hom.app (Opposite.op T)
      = (picEt C).map ((twRestrict (k := k) γ).inv.app T).op := by
  simp [actRestricted]

noncomputable def actPicEt (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    (Tw (k := k) γ).op ⋙ picEt (Scheme.baseChangeField C k')
      ≅ picEt (Scheme.baseChangeField C k') :=
  Functor.isoWhiskerLeft _ (picEt_crossBaseIso C k') ≪≫
    actRestricted C γ ≪≫ (picEt_crossBaseIso C k').symm

variable {X' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k'))}
  (rep : (picEt (Scheme.baseChangeField C k')).RepresentableBy X')

/-- The twist morphism at the representing object. -/
noncomputable def twMor (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') : (Tw (k := k) γ).obj X' ⟶ X' :=
  rep.homEquiv.symm ((actPicEt C γ).inv.app (Opposite.op X') (rep.homEquiv (𝟙 X')))

/-- Semilinearity square: FREE, it is `Over.w`. -/
theorem twMor_w (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    (twMor C rep γ).left ≫ X'.hom = X'.hom ≫ (toSpecAut (k' ≃ₐ[k] k') k' γ).hom :=
  Over.w (twMor C rep γ)

/-- IS THE TWIST AN ISO? Try both routes. -/
example (γ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') : IsIso (twMor C rep γ).left := by
  sorry

/-- Multiplicativity at the object level -- is it free? -/
example (γ τ : k' ≃ₐ[k] k') :
    (twMor C rep (γ * τ)).left
      = (twMor C rep τ).left ≫ (twMor C rep γ).left := by
  sorry

end Act

end Probe
